detailed_description:
Critical composition rule: the reference video's special compositions must stay visible and persistent instead of collapsing into an ordinary unstructured frame. Shot 1 keeps a frame-within-frame: the left doorway frame forms the inner frame's left border and the mirror edge forms its right border, and the woman stays centered inside that inner rectangle while her hands travel forward inside it. Shot 2 keeps two layered structures: a picture-in-picture inset fixed at the upper-left corner and sitting above the main image, holding a second hand view; and a foreground frame formed by near fingers and a small dark flower that stay slightly out of focus at the frame edge and partially frame the sharp midground hands.
[Shot 1] 0-4s, vertical 9:16, eye level, medium to medium-close framing. Use <video_1> as the timing, framing, camera-language, composition, special-layout and beat-structure reference for this shot. The scene is the warm indoor mirror corner from <picture_3>, a simple warm-lit room with a large freestanding mirror, a left doorway frame, warm key light with soft falloff and an uncluttered background. The performer is the non-identifiable adult woman from <picture_2>, with short dark hair, a fitted dark glossy top with subtle metallic silver surface texture, dark structured bottoms, dark metallic jewellery and restrained dark smoky make-up. Keep the camera essentially static at eye level with a very slight follow of the hands and no push, pan or zoom; keep focus on her upper body and hands with the indoor background softly defocused; keep the top safe area clean and empty. In the opening beat (0-2.3s) the woman stands centered inside the inner rectangle with both hands resting on her hips and the long dark gothic nails from <picture_1> worn on both hands, partially readable at this distance. In the second beat (2.3-4.0s) the same woman lifts both hands from her hips and travels them forward toward the lens inside the same inner frame, both palms facing the lens with fingers spread, until the long dark gothic nail design from <picture_1> fills a tight extreme close-up with natural motion blur; the inner frame stays visible around the moving hands. The shot ends on this completed forward display and cuts hard to the next shot at 4.0s.
At 00:04.000, hard cut to the outdoor highland scene from <picture_4>, a blue sky with white clouds, layered green meadow and a calm distant lake under high-saturation natural daylight. The same woman from <picture_2> now wears a dark gothic outdoor look with a short dark bob, a dark off-shoulder top with gothic lace texture and dark metallic jewellery. Keep the same eye-level, essentially static camera with a very slight follow of the hands, a centered composition with the woman on the vertical midline, depth layering with her hands in the near foreground, her body in the midground and the meadow and lake behind, focus on the hands and nail surfaces with the meadow and lake softly defocused, and clean upper and lower safe areas. She raises both hands to the sides of her face with fingers spread and holds the spread-finger display so the same long dark gothic nail design from <picture_1> reads clearly for the first time against the meadow and lake. Midway through the shot she moves one hand to her chin for a light touch, then holds a tight hand close-up in which her fingertips pinch a small dark flower, turn it slowly and settle into a small second adjustment; the pinched flower and her fingers stay slightly out of focus at the frame edge as a foreground frame around the sharp midground hands. In the final beat of the shot a small inset window is fixed at the upper-left corner, about a quarter of the frame width, layered above the main image, and inside it a second camera angle shows the same dark gothic nails and hand against the distant lake while the main region keeps the centered hand display and the meadow; the main camera stays static and only the hands keep the very slight follow. The shot holds this layered main display plus inset and cuts hard to the next shot at 9.0s.
At 00:09.000, hard cut to the outdoor metal tower scene from <picture_5>, a bare metal lattice tower against a bright blue sky with a green grass slope under cooler natural daylight. The same woman from <picture_2> now wears a dark gothic long coat over a dark top and keeps the same short dark bob and the same long dark gothic nail design from <picture_1>. Keep the eye-level, essentially static camera with a very slight follow of the hands, a centered composition with the woman on the vertical midline and the tower structure behind her, medium framing that moves to a tight hand close-up, focus on the hands and nail surfaces with the tower and grass slope softly defocused, and clean top and bottom safe areas. She raises both hands toward the lens with palms forward and fingers spread, holds the spread-finger display, then makes one small posture adjustment while the dark nails stay in frame, proving the same design under the new wardrobe and cooler light. The shot completes the palm-forward display and cuts hard to the closing shot at 11.0s.
At 00:11.000, hard cut back to the outdoor highland meadow and sky from <picture_4> under the same natural daylight, with the same eye-level, essentially static camera and a very slight follow of the hands, a centered composition with the woman on the vertical midline, medium framing moving to a hand close-up, depth layering with her hands in the near foreground, her body in the midground and the meadow and sky behind, focus on the hands and nail surfaces with the outdoor background softly defocused, and clean top and bottom safe areas. The same woman from <picture_2> continues the dark gothic long coat from the previous shot and now adds a dark wide-brim hat; with the hat-finished styling held, she holds both hands forward toward the lens with the long dark gothic nail display from <picture_1> visible and settles into a closing held pose. This closing shot inherits only the reference beat structure: a single held closing beat after the hard cut in which the nail display completes and settles.
